title: Migration, New Version
author: requiem.moe
body:
Well! It has been a while since this site was up and running, sorry about that! I have been busy.. very busy, from migrating servers, to building HUGE projects, I just haven't had the time to update this site or push the new release.
Sadly to say, I forgot to migrate the old blog images... Pre-1.5.2 blog posts will have 0 images until I manually add them at some point... Whenever that may be.
Anyways the new version is out with some bugs ill fix when I get the time.

As for my mental health, I am off my meds completely and I feel just fine. Weird how that happens when you're not being bullied constantly :D. 

#CEO soon!
